description: Phase 1: Security & Compliance fixes - NoSQL injection, OData injection, HTML escaping, unsubscribe links, AuthGuard on protected routes, ISR cache key and Set-Cookie stripping
steps: 1. Fix NoSQL injection in apps/backend/app/api/v1/content.py: Add regex validation (^[a-z0-9-]+$) for all path parameters (board, class_level, subject, chapter, page_type) in render_chapter, render_chapter_page_type, list_chapters, and get_by_slug endpoints. Raise HTTPException(400) if validation fails. Import 're' module.

2. Fix OData injection in apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py: In _async_search method, validate user_tier against an explicit allowlist ['free', 'pro'] before constructing filter_expr. If user_tier is not in the allowlist AND not None, set it to None (skip filtering). Log a warning for invalid tier values.

3. Add HTML escaping to email templates in apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py: Import html module. Use html.escape() on all user-provided values injected into HTML templates: 'name' in send_welcome_email, 'event_id' in send_receipt_email, 'reset_token' in send_password_reset_email (the token goes into href, so also URL-encode it with urllib.parse.quote).

4. Add unsubscribe links to all email templates in apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py: Add a standard unsubscribe footer to each email template HTML (send_welcome_email, send_receipt_email, send_password_reset_email) with a link to https://syrabit.ai/profile?unsubscribe=true. Also add List-Unsubscribe header to the _send_email function's JSON payload as 'headers': {'List-Unsubscribe': '<https://syrabit.ai/profile?unsubscribe=true>'}.

5. Wrap protected routes with AuthGuard in apps/frontend/src/App.jsx: Wrap the following routes with <AuthGuard>...</AuthGuard>: /chat (ChatPage), /read (BrowsePage), /history (HistoryPage), /profile (ProfilePage), /profile/memories (MyMemoriesPage), /notebook (NotebookPage), /flashcards (FlashcardsPage), /guardian (GuardianPage). These routes currently have no auth protection.

6. Fix ISR cache key to include query params in apps/edge/src/routes/isr.ts: Change 'const cacheKey = url.pathname;' to 'const cacheKey = url.pathname + url.search;' so that different query parameter combinations get separate cache entries.

7. Strip Set-Cookie from ISR cached responses in apps/edge/src/routes/isr.ts: After fetching from backend (the response object), delete the 'Set-Cookie' header from the response before caching. When building the Response for cache MISS, ensure no Set-Cookie header is present in the returned headers.
acceptance_criteria: Path parameters with special characters (e.g., {$gt:''}) return HTTP 400 in content.py endpoints
user_tier values not in ['free', 'pro'] are ignored (filter not applied) in azure_search.py
All user-provided values in email HTML are escaped with html.escape()
Password reset token is URL-encoded in the reset link
All email templates include an unsubscribe footer link
ISR cached responses do not contain Set-Cookie headers

Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
Verify grep for html.escape in resend_client.py
Verify grep for AuthGuard wrapping in App.jsx for protected routes
findings: All 7 steps implemented. Ruff check passes clean on all 3 backend files. TypeScript noEmit passes for edge worker. pnpm install was needed to resolve @cloudflare/workers-types. pyenv global 3.11.15 set for python commands.
